title: Start with no proof
trigger: The In Progress job and its saved-proof list have loaded successfully, with no rows.
expected: Show one compact saved-proof workspace with an empty state and Add proof action. Add proof opens a separate content dialog without shifting saved proof.
action: Open Add proof and enter a delivery link.

title: Paste a delivery link
trigger: The marketer enters a candidate delivery URL.
expected: Show the Delivery link field in the content dialog. Keep the attachment type fixed internally to Proof. URL shape alone does not verify remote sharing permissions.

title: Save once
expected: Submit once and retain the draft until confirmation. Continue browsing closes the form while saving continues; View progress reopens it. A 12-second deadline or document return restores explicit uncertainty and check-before-retry.

title: Proof is saved
trigger: The save receives a confirmed success response.
expected: Show one saved Proof URL and its server-generated timestamp. Clear the draft only after confirmation.
action: Add another proof or review the saved evidence.

title: Add another link
trigger: The marketer starts a second proof while existing evidence is present.
expected: Keep existing evidence in the saved-proof workspace while editing in a separate content dialog, without shifting the list.

title: Review delivery evidence
trigger: The saved-proof list contains multiple records.
expected: Show full clickable URLs and timestamps newest first. Saving proof does not complete the job.
action: Review a link or add another proof while the job is In Progress.

title: Correct the URL
trigger: The marketer submits an empty or malformed URL.
expected: Keep the draft, show an inline field error, focus the input, and create no saved row.

title: Attachment type rejected
trigger: The simulated server rejects the Proof attachment type.
expected: Show an explicit rejection, create no visible row, and retain the URL for recovery.

title: Connection lost during save
trigger: The save response is interrupted and its outcome is unknown.
expected: Do not optimistically show a saved row or submit again. Read the authoritative list before deciding whether a retry is safe.

title: Checked: link was not saved
trigger: A successful reconciliation read confirms the new link is absent.
expected: Keep the URL and make one explicit retry available. Never replay the original request automatically.
action: Choose Save proof to make a new explicit attempt.

title: Saved proof cannot load
expected: Show a consistent top-left return, page header and one recovery group. Do not present failed loading as an empty list or enable submission without known context.

title: Job status has changed
trigger: A fresh response says the job is no longer In Progress.
expected: Remove the submit action and refresh the job context before showing its current status.

title: Access is no longer available
trigger: The server denies access to the job.
expected: Clear private job details, proof URLs, and the unsaved draft from the screen.

title: Loading saved proof
trigger: The initial job and saved-proof read is pending.
expected: Show neutral progress and Stop waiting, plus navigation. After 12 seconds expose read recovery. Do not imply an empty list or enable submit while context is unknown.
